title: Evaluation of the French Maternal and Child Protection Services From 11 French Territories That Have Received Common Intervention Guidelines
brief_summary: The PANJO study aims to evaluate, within the French public health services, the impact of a home visitors training on parent-child attachment, families outcomes, use of services and child maltreatment indicators.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Nulliparous
* Pregnant \<32 weeks of amenorrhea
* Answers yes to the following question: "do you feel alone facing the upcoming changes related to your child"

Exclusion Criteria:

* Intends to move outside the area in which she can receive the intervention
* Sees a psychologist or psychiatrist at least once per week
* Refuses to participate
